review.evidence: The named owner and proxy administrator are closed at Ethereum block 26110183, including all six current signer addresses and the code-enforced absence of a timelock or Safe-style modules. Quarterly BDO ISAE3000R reasonable-assurance reports reconcile shared fiat-token reserves to aggregate liabilities, not a dedicated MXNT allocation. BDO excludes Notes 2.2's CNAD authorization assertion from its assurance scope. That issuer assertion is now independently anchored: on 2026-10-03 the rendered CNAD registry's Emisores de Ofertas Publicas de Monedas Estables tab named Tether International S.A. de C.V., EME-0003, registered May 19, 2025. Current Tether holder terms bind fiat-token obligations to that same entity and explicitly include MXNT in section 4.1. This supports prudential supervision under the same CNAD registered-issuer convention used for XAUT's separate TG Commodities entity; USAT's OCC-supervised Anchorage issuer is distinct and is not imputed to MXNT. Periodic reconciliation retains the same BDO fiat-token report family that covers USDT and MXNT. Dedicated MXNT asset-liability, custody and segregation evidence remains absent; named custodian allocation, enforceable bankruptcy priority and independent reserve mix remain unavailable. Issuer redemption has a USD100,000-equivalent minimum and fee floor; SLA and capacity are not guaranteed, with no proved small-holder DEX backstop. Independent human/key-custody/HSM arrangements for the six identified signers and operational hold periods remain undisclosed. The official zero-supply Tron token has decimals=0 and lacks a full local issuance/upgrader/freeze review: it remains inactive and excluded from the reviewed Ethereum deployment. Do not author the nonresolving geckoId mexican-peso-tether (detail 404, stale price and zero cap); its historical chart is not a current trustworthy peg record. Fresh current owner() calls for MXNT, USDT and XAUT all returned the exact same Ethereum MultiSigWallet 0xc6cde7c39eb2f0f0095f41570af89efc2c1ea828. Its 5,705-byte deployed runtime has SHA-256 a658996593d84755b24195fc9c863efc567cd43610e736c461a85a229671eac2 and equals Blockscout's reviewed deployed reference bytes. Blockscout's is_fully_verified=false/is_partially_verified=true and Sourcify's runtimeMatch=match remain explicit compiler-verification qualifications, not a unique MXNT umbrella penalty on the byte-identical wallet already accepted for USDT/XAUT. Human independence and signing-policy questions remain scoped to that shared control.
